notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Current Elections page (CivicPlus Document Center) lists for each 2026 election 'Unofficial Early Results', 'Unofficial Final/Total Results', 'Official Results', a canvass PDF and reconciliation forms. The unofficial reports are Electionware 'Summary Results Report' county totals split by Absentee/Early Voting/Election Day: 2026 primary Republican 'Unofficial Final Results' footer 'Election Summary - Republican - 03/03/2026 9:06 PM' (CreationDate 4 Mar 2026 03:19 UTC = 9:19 PM CST); 2026 runoff Republican 'Unofficial Total Results' footer '05/26/2026 8:17 PM' (CreationDate 27 May 2026 02:23 UTC). The 'Official Results' (CreationDate 10 Mar 2026) are also Summary Results Reports; precinct numbers, if any, appear only in the canvass PDFs (not opened). No election-night precinct report is listed. The CivicPlus server stamps every file with the request time as Last-Modified, so there is no upload evidence. 2024 general results are not on the current site (no archive page found on the Elections pages). OCR noise in quoted PDF text was normalized. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data not present). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 21:06 CT; 2026_runoff LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-05-26 20:17 CT.
